newsitem.title: JORDAN: PLO's Arafat to hold talks with King Hussein.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Arafat to hold talks with King Hussein.

text.p: Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat was expected in Amman on Sunday to brief King Hussein on Egyptian efforts to break a deadlock in Middle East peacemaking, officials said.
They said Arafat would consult the king on the latest Egyptian moves to revive Israeli-Palestinian talks, halted since March when Israel started a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
Israeli and PLO officials were to meet in Cairo on Sunday amid few signs of an end to the impasse by the two sides, who remain entrenched in their positions.

Since a government headed by Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali came to power last March, Jordan has pursued a more cautious role in Israeli-Palestinian peace moves, in contrast to Egypt which has replaced Washington as the main mediator, officials say.
